name: Immediate Stop after Say or Think
hint: The script stops everything immediately after the [sbi]say ()[/sbi] or [sbi]think ()[/sbi] block. The text is never shown.
instruction: Replace the [sbi]say ()[/sbi] or [sbi]think ()[/sbi] block with a [sbi]say ( ) for ( ) seconds[/sbi] or [sbi]think ( ) for ( ) seconds[/sbi] block.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when i start as a clone
forever
if <touching (mouse-pointer v) ?> then
change [points v] by (1)
say [Ooohhh...] :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
stop [all v]
end
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when i start as a clone
forever
if <touching (mouse-pointer v) ?> then
change [points v] by (1)
say [Ooohhh...] for (3) seconds  :: #007000 //⇦  👍
stop [all v]
end
end
